charts.title: HD 93963 A c: orbits around HD 93963 A
charts.description: The orbits of HD 93963 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 93963 A c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname POLANSKI_ET_AL__2024): P 3.6451389 d

charts.title: HD 93963 A c: its transit
charts.description: HD 93963 A c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (22, 48) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 368435330, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
